_readme: Tells the launcher where your head unit publishes car data (fuel, range, trip computer).
Every head unit / CAN-bus decoder does this differently, so this file is filled in once we
know which app on YOUR unit reads the CAN bus (see Launcher > Diagnostics on the unit).
Each broadcast entry: the intent action the vendor app sends, and which extra holds which value.
Field names the launcher understands: fuel_litres, fuel_percent, range_km, temp_c,
ss_distance_km, ss_time_min, ss_consumption_kml, ss_consumption_l100, ss_avg_speed_kmh (since start),
rf_... the same five fields for since refuelling,
'scale' multiplies the raw value (e.g. 0.1 if the unit sends tenths).
